title: Atomic Theory and Structure - Chemistry - Electromagnetic Radiation
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which equation correctly represents the relationship between the speed of light $(c)$, wavelength ($\lambda$), and frequency ($\nu$)?
questions.explain: The speed of light is the product of wavelength and frequency: $c = \lambda\nu$.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: What happens to the frequency of a light wave if its wavelength increases?
questions.explain: Wavelength and frequency are inversely proportional ($c = \lambda\nu$). If wavelength increases, frequency must decrease to keep $(c)$ constant.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: According to the equation $E = h\nu$, the energy of a photon is directly proportional to its:
questions.explain: In Planck's equation $E = h\nu$, Energy $(E)$ is directly proportional to Frequency ($\nu$).
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which of the following types of electromagnetic radiation has the highest energy?
questions.explain: Gamma rays have the highest frequency and thus the highest energy in the electromagnetic spectrum.
questions.subject: Chemistry
